naruto.book.page1:
So you want to be a shinobi.

Open the jutsu menu with J. Every technique is cast by pressing a short string of hand seals - the keys for chakra, shape and nature.
naruto.book.page2:
Chakra is your fuel.

C C charges it. It trickles back on its own, faster at night if you have an affinity, and a full night's sleep refills it completely.
naruto.book.page3:
Techniques are bought, not given.

J, then Skill Tree. Experience buys skill points (10 XP each); points buy nodes. Most techniques - and even the double jump - start locked.
naruto.book.page4:
Start with the basics.

C B B V calls a shadow clone. Hold the last key to sit down and meditate with it instead: clones feed you chakra and speed up every cooldown.
naruto.book.page5:
Scrolls are found, not crafted.

Strongholds, bastions and the ends of the world hide scrolls. Read one and its technique can be learned; a duplicate sharpens the technique you already know.
naruto.book.page6:
Titles follow deeds.

Genin, Chunin, Jonin, S-rank - the village promotes on learned skills and on the great monsters you bring down. Keep the handbook; the rest you learn on the road.

narutoaddon:armor_collapse.desc: Crushes the armour off a body and leaves it weak.
narutoaddon:space_drill.desc: Fires a beam of cut space: it drills a three-by-three hole where it lands, every tick. Tap to switch between vanishing the blocks (cheap) and dropping them as items (costly).

narutoaddon:flesh_rupture.desc: Pulls and pushes one body at once, tearing it apart.
narutoaddon:gravity_drill.desc: Shoves earth and stone aside while held, boring a tunnel through them.

narutoaddon:size_shift.desc: The size dial: hold the combo to open it and scroll the mouse wheel to slide between half and five times your size, then let go to keep that size. Tap the combo to snap back to normal. The body takes its size with it: a grown caster has five times the health, strides heavily and hits in an arc, while a small one has half the health but moves faster, takes no fall damage and goes unnoticed past three blocks. The grown body also breaks a whole N-by-N-by-N cube of blocks with every swing, up to five by five by five; blocks the held tool cannot harvest simply vanish without a drop.
narutoaddon:black_rod_throw.desc: Hurls a black rod that pins the target to the ground for a minute. If it is killed while pinned, the rod bursts: every enemy within ten blocks withers for ten seconds.
narutoaddon:cube_summon.desc: Drops a black cube on the target that crushes everything under it.
narutoaddon:gravity_well.desc: A black micro-hole drags every body into one heap and bursts.
narutoaddon:telekinesis_loot.desc: Draws every dropped item within thirty blocks through the walls to the caster.
narutoaddon:projectile_reflect.desc: A shield that turns arrows and fireballs back at whoever threw them.
narutoaddon:gravity_press.desc: Weighs every body around the caster down and pins it to the ground.
narutoaddon:zero_gravity.desc: Lifts every enemy around the caster into the air while the key is held.

narutomod.note.title: A Torn Note
narutomod.note.1: Never chase a ninja into a forest. The forest is on their side, and you are the one who is lost.
narutomod.note.2: A shadow clone that comes back with a story always leaves out how tired it was.
narutomod.note.3: The hand seals are not the technique. They are how you convince yourself the technique will work.
narutomod.note.4: Water walks anyone who is too angry to notice they are standing on it.
narutomod.note.5: A kunai thrown and lost is a ryo wasted; a kunai thrown and found is a ryo earned.
narutomod.note.6: When the eyes are stronger than the body, the body is what breaks.

narutoaddon:chakra_trail.desc: Marks a body with chakra the Sharingan can follow through walls for thirty seconds.
narutoaddon:suggestion.desc: Makes the creature before you forget you for eight seconds, or a trader offer you a much better price for a minute.
narutoaddon:tsukuyomi.desc: Holds the mind you are looking at in a second of hell: six points of mental damage and three seconds without sight, thought or movement.
narutoaddon:kurai.desc: Puts out the lights in one mind: four seconds of blindness and three of confusion, with no wound left behind.
narutoaddon:izanagi.desc: Spends the eye to rewrite your own death: for five seconds the next blow that would kill you is refused, leaving you at 40% health and blind for forty-five seconds.
narutoaddon:izanami.desc: Marks the mind under your gaze for ten seconds; three blows from the same hand close the loop, freezing the victim for four seconds and leaving it weak.
narutoaddon:kotoamatsukami.desc: Convinces a creature under your gaze that you are an ally for six seconds, so it will not take you for a target until you strike it.
narutoaddon:player_genjutsu.desc: Turns the illusion on another ninja: darkness, vertigo and a broken rhythm for a few seconds. Only works when the server allows illusions on players.
narutoaddon:face_swap.desc: The victim sees your face on every other body, is left blind and reeling, and you go unseen for six seconds. Only works when the server allows illusions on players.

narutoaddon:blade_parry.desc: Raise one of the mod's swords on right-click: the next blow or technique that lands is turned aside and answered with a cut. Spends stamina.
narutoaddon:vacuum_blade.desc: A crescent of wind drawn off the edge of the blade: a short cone is opened, a quarter of the cut passes through armour, and the wound keeps bleeding. The sharper the blade, the deeper the cut: damage scales with the sword in hand.
narutoaddon:palm_block.desc: Empty hands raised as a guard: half of the blows that land are caught on the palms, and the striker is answered.
narutoaddon:inner_strike.desc: A short palm to the body that breaks a held technique, and leaves a creature without a mind of its own for a moment.
narutoaddon:gate_peacock.desc: Eight blazing palms in a single breath, paid for with the caster's own strength.
narutoaddon:gate_tiger.desc: A fist of compressed air: a five-block blast that throws bodies back and leaves the ground untouched.
narutoaddon:gate_elephant.desc: The last of the three: an eight-block shockwave that leaves the caster on two points of health.

narutoaddon:chakra_transfer.desc: A thread of chakra to an ally, paid one tick at a time.
narutoaddon:clone_decoy.desc: Leave two empty copies behind to draw every eye but your own.
narutoaddon:clone_medic.desc: A copy that stands by and closes your wounds instead of fighting.
narutoaddon:shuriken_shadow.desc: Throw two shadow shurikens. The first to land vanishes and leaves a one-health combat clone in its place, armed with whatever you are holding.
narutoaddon:mokuton_growth.desc: Hurry the crops and saplings in a small patch of ground.
narutoaddon:suiton_watering.desc: Soak every tilled block around you without a drop of rain.
narutoaddon:wind_step.desc: Run a quarter faster and step up a full block while the chakra holds.
narutoaddon:beast_carry.desc: Hoist a small creature onto your shoulders and keep it there.
narutoaddon:clone_swap.desc: Trade places with the nearest of your own clones within thirty-two blocks; both of you land braced for the first half second.
narutoaddon:water_clone.desc: A body of water wearing your face: it stays on a short leash, takes only part of every blow and smothers the fire it touches.
narutoaddon:mud_clone.desc: Raises two copies of packed mud, four hits each; whichever one is broken drags the feet of everything standing in it.
narutoaddon:clay_clone.desc: A copy packed with clay: it walks in like a clone and goes off like a charge when it is broken, without cracking a single block.
narutoaddon:projectile_cut.desc: A scythe of wind that cuts arrows, fireballs and thrown things out of the air and nicks every body in the arc.
narutoaddon:drunken_fist.desc: The unreadable sway: one blow in four goes past the caster, and one in seven of the caster's own misses. Requires a drink of sake first, and the world swims while it is held.
narutoaddon:chakra_dash.desc: A short step along the look that stops at the first wall.
narutoaddon:limbo.desc: An unseen copy of the caster holds the ground where they look and strikes from the border of the world.
narutoaddon:amenominaka.desc: Drags everything living nearby into the void with the caster and gives it all back eight seconds later.
narutoaddon:yin_yang_heal.desc: A held seal that mends wounds fast - the target's and the caster's own - and burns poison, withering and blindness out of them.
narutoaddon:curse_seal_one.desc: The first stage of the curse seal: strength, speed and toughness for as long as the chakra holds, paid for in health up front and half of every heal while it is open.
narutoaddon:curse_seal_two.desc: Worn on top of the first stage: heavier blows, a higher leap and a soft fall, paid for in hunger and a quarter of all healing.
narutoaddon:chakra_cloak.desc: A shell of chakra over the skin: four armour and two attack damage, no glow to give you away, and no room to shape another technique - except the tailed cloak pulled over it, the beast bomb thrown from that tail, the sage charging and mode worn together with the beast, and the light utility arts (charge, fist, dash, leap, double jump, water walk).
narutoaddon:tailed_cloak.desc: The cloak drawn out into a tail: twelve armour, harder hits, faster feet, a higher leap and quicker digging, a sweep that answers whoever hunts you within five blocks, and a roar that marks out nearby mobs.
narutoaddon:lightning_mode.desc: A third faster for as long as the charge holds, with a shock for every melee attacker; water or rain grounds it at once.
narutoaddon:orochimaru_body.desc: Shed a wounded body: fire, poison, wither and slowness fall away, and a three-second shell of resistance covers the new one for a share of your chakra and six points of health.
narutoaddon:seal_vessel.desc: Draw the cage a tailed beast is written into: five seconds of standing still leaves a vessel of three tails and one hundred integrity, and every form of the beast's chakra is read through it.
narutoaddon:divided_cloak.desc: Share the vessel's chakra with everyone on your side within six blocks: two armour, one attack damage and a little speed, at a trickle of chakra and a slow wear on the vessel.
narutoaddon:seal_break.desc: Force the seal open for eight seconds: speed, strength and a beast's hide, with a sweep every second and no allies spared - then six health and a fifth of the vessel are taken.
narutoaddon:perfect_cloak.desc: Wear the beast's chakra with its agreement: blinding speed, heavy resistance and ten attack damage, a wind-like leap, digging through stone like sand, with two chakra arms that strike your hunters for eight every second.
narutoaddon:tailed_ball.desc: Hold the keys to grow a black sphere of beast chakra in front of you - three seconds for a full one - then let go to throw it. It flies where you look and comes apart in a heavy blast that by default wounds but breaks nothing; an operator can arm the blocks with /naruto debug bomb.
narutoaddon:clone_sparring.desc: Take one of your own clones aside to train: both halves of the spar learn, and the copy pulls its blows.
narutoaddon:clone_sacrifice.desc: Hold the seal and the blow that would have killed you takes the nearest clone instead, leaving you on four hearts.
narutoaddon:iron_guardian.desc: Raise an iron guardian where you are looking; it holds that spot for a minute and only hunts the hostile.
narutoaddon:blade_rain.desc: Unroll the scroll of blades: sixteen shuriken spread across the look in a single fan.
narutoaddon:explosion_silencer.desc: Draw a seal that swallows blasts around it for forty-five seconds: half the force and no broken ground. A ring of glyphs marks the edge of the silenced ground.
narutoaddon:katsuyu_network.desc: In sage mode, open a healing field that mends every ally nearby and washes poison and withering away.
narutoaddon:chakra_whetstone.desc: Run chakra along the edge of the held sword and put part of its durability back. A novice restores a twentieth, a master a quarter. Ten seconds before the arm can do it again.
narutoaddon:kamae.desc: The three guards of the sword - high, middle and low. Each raising steps on to the next: high adds a tenth of damage, middle gives resistance, low gives a tenth of speed. Costs stamina every tick and needs a blade in hand.
narutoaddon:kusa_giri.desc: A scythe stroke that takes every ripe crop, bush and leaf in a three by three box in front of the caster, as if picked by hand. Stone, soil and trunks are left where they are.
narutoaddon:kesa_giri.desc: A diagonal cut across a hundred and twenty degrees at sword distance: up to three bodies take six damage, a quarter of it straight through armour.
narutoaddon:flame_fist.desc: Three burning blows at arm's length, four ticks apart. The last one leaves the target on fire.
narutoaddon:water_hand.desc: A film of water worn over the arm: two blocks of extra reach, a push on every blow, and the caster's own fire put out each tick.
narutoaddon:hiramekarei.desc: The hammer-blade's art, used by right-clicking Hiramekarei: for ten seconds every blow lands half again as hard, and sneaking brings it down into the stone under the target.
narutoaddon:shibuki.desc: The blast sword's art, used by right-clicking Shibuki: a sealed charge set off in the air in front of the caster, eight damage in two and a half blocks with the world untouched. Sneak while right-clicking instead to open a short tunnel through stone.
narutoaddon:bleeding_blade.desc: The edge left in the wound: every cut keeps bleeding for five seconds after the blade has moved on.
narutoaddon:elemental_edge.desc: The caster's own nature carried into the steel: every blow adds two damage of that element past the armour, and leaves the target burning, soaked or dried out. Sneak while casting to cycle the element covering the blade. Fire sets ablaze, water soaks and chills, wind knocks back, earth weakens, wood calls down lightning.

narutoaddon:mind_transfer.desc: The Yamanaka transfer: the mind goes into the creature in the crosshair for twenty seconds and leaves its own body standing empty, taking double damage.
narutoaddon:size_expansion.desc: Partial Multi-Size: the arm reaches two blocks further, and every step costs a third of its pace.
narutoaddon:camellia_dance.desc: Grow a bone blade into your hand. For ten seconds its cuts land two to four damage harder (more with mastery), a quarter cuts through armour and the wound keeps bleeding. The blade itself is good for only eight strikes, cannot be repaired and cannot be enchanted.
narutoaddon:bone_bullets.desc: Hold the seal to fire a stream of bone shards: one a second at first, accelerating to several a second. Each shard costs chakra, so the stream lasts only as long as the pool does.
narutoaddon:six_paths_mode.desc: Pours the whole gathered ritual out at once: a minute of flight, a body that closes its own wounds, and nine Truth-Seeking Orbs. Needs an open Rinnegan and a hundred nature energy.
narutoaddon:gudodama_launch.desc: Throws one black orb along your gaze. It stops at the first wall or body and takes twenty from everything within four blocks, leaving the ground untouched.
narutoaddon:gudodama_guard.desc: Turns the orbs as a ring that swallows every shot inside three blocks, spending one orb per shot.
narutoaddon:gudodama_form.desc: Shapes an orb into a weapon: six more damage on every blow and a fifth of all damage taken swallowed. Costs one orb every five seconds.
narutoaddon:rinne_sharingan.desc: The third eye on the forehead. Sees in the dark and makes illusions and black flames cheaper to hold. Needs the Six Paths mode.
narutoaddon:sewing_pocket.desc: Cut an ender chest out of the seam beside you and hold it open for ten seconds.
narutoaddon:sewing_lock.desc: Hold: sew a door, gate, lid or chest to its frame for as long as you keep holding - paid once, free afterwards. A tap cuts the seam loose again. On a block that is not a door, gate, lid or chest a tap shears the block itself, which comes away whole.
narutoaddon:black_rod.desc: Drives a rod of the outer path into a block face. Every ninja within three blocks of it stops recovering chakra and is lit up.
narutoaddon:item_attraction.desc: Draws every loose item within twelve blocks to the caster's hand and clears its pickup delay.

narutoaddon:kai.desc: Break an illusion on yourself and on every ally beside you.
narutoaddon:chakra_grip.desc: Holds one body in place and leaks its chakra for as long as the hand stays closed.
narutoaddon:byakugan_farsight.desc: Narrows the view onto one distant thing. Nothing else is granted while it is held.
narutoaddon:byakugan_sonar.desc: A warden-like pulse rings out from the block you strike and lights every ore within twenty-four blocks.
narutoaddon:juken_stance.desc: Works only while the Byakugan is open. Every blow sends out a wave of chakra, burns the enemy's chakra and ignores part of their armour.
narutoaddon:juken_purge.desc: Strips every positive effect from the target.
narutoaddon:palm_lance.desc: A lunging palm down the line of sight: the caster is carried into the target, which is struck, thrown back and left slow.
narutoaddon:eight_trigrams_collapse.desc: Eight palms walked in one motion: everything in a three-wide, eight-deep lane in front of the caster is struck, thrown into the air and left heavy.
narutoaddon:sixty_four_palms.desc: Fixes on the body in front of the caster and walks the whole kata into it: a palm every four ticks, sixty-four in all, each taking chakra and closing the tenketsu until the last leaves the body weak and slow.
narutoaddon:air_palm.desc: A wedge of chakra pushed out of the hand: everything in a six-block cone is thrown back, drained of chakra and left weak for three seconds.
narutoaddon:circular_block.desc: A turning ring of chakra around the body: two blows in five are turned away and their thrower is shoved off the circle.

narutoaddon:naraka_path: Naraka Path: Court of the King of Hell
narutoaddon:naraka_path.desc: Raises a court for eight seconds: allies inside are healed and cleansed, enemies are left weak.
narutoaddon:animal_path.desc: Calls three wolves tamed to you; they fight beside you for a minute and then return to the ground.
narutoaddon:asura_missiles.desc: Three seekers leave your arm and strike the nearest enemies a moment later, through no wall and no shield.
narutoaddon:rinbo_hengoku.desc: An invisible echo repeats every melee blow you land, at half its weight, a quarter of a second later.
narutoaddon:outer_chains.desc: Pins up to three enemies in front of you while the channel holds; they may still fight, but not move.
narutoaddon:outer_armor.desc: A shell of chakra: more armour, a fifth of every blow turned aside, no knockback, and slower feet.
narutoaddon:susanoo.desc: The ribcage of a god, worn as a stance: blows land on the ribs instead of the body, at the price of chakra every tick - and of the eye itself after thirty seconds of unbroken use.
narutoaddon:illusory_double.desc: Leave a copy of yourself where you are not. It carries no gear and cannot hurt anything, but everything that was hunting you lunges at it for six seconds - and only the Sharingan can see it for what it is.

jutsu.sharingan.strain: Your eye gives out under the strain!

narutoaddon:ore_excavation.desc: Tears the ore out of the ground around you and follows each vein through the rock. Works on anything the pack marks as an ore.
narutoaddon:ore_vein_mining.desc: A stance for the mastered miner: every ore you break by hand pulls its whole vein out for chakra, so a seam is one swing instead of twenty.
naruto.skill.elem_ore_vein.name: Living Pickaxe
naruto.skill.elem_ore_vein.desc: Learn the mining stance that empties a vein from the first block.
narutoaddon:wide_dig.desc: A toggle that turns every block you break into a three-by-three tunnel face; the swing decides the direction.
narutoaddon:ore_sense.desc: A short pulse that shows the ore around you through stone. One burst with a cooldown, not a held sense.
narutoaddon:campfire.desc: Lights the log under your crosshair where it stands, leaving a campfire for light, cooking and warmth.
narutoaddon:rasengan.desc: Hold to grow a sphere of chakra in your hand; release to drive it into whatever is in front. A longer hold hits harder.
narutoaddon:rasenshuriken.desc: Hold to charge the rasengan into a thrown wind disc. The longer the charge, the faster and harder it flies.
narutoaddon:eight_gates.desc: Each tap opens the next inner gate: faster, stronger and tougher while they are open. Hold the last key to seal them all again.
narutoaddon:kamui.desc: Tap to step into your pocket dimension and back. Hold to drag whatever you are looking at into it with you.
narutoaddon:kamui_phasing.desc: A toggle that turns your body to smoke, letting you pass through walls and blows. Costs chakra every tick.
narutoaddon:chakra_thread.desc: Throw a line of chakra at what you are looking at; it reels you to it or it to you. The catch is fixed when the cast starts.
narutoaddon:chakra_adhesion.desc: A toggle that spreads chakra under your hands and feet, letting you stick to and climb walls and ceilings.
narutoaddon:body_adaptation.desc: A survival toggle: under water you breathe, in lava you do not burn, in powder snow you do not freeze.
narutoaddon:smoke_screen.desc: Bursts a bank of smoke that hides everyone inside it, yourself included. Good for breaking a chase or a line of sight.
narutoaddon:chakra_feeding.desc: A toggle that slowly turns chakra into food, keeping you fed on a long journey. It tops the bar up, it does not fill it.
narutoaddon:silence.desc: A toggle that swallows the noise you make: sculk sensors, shriekers and the warden no longer hear your steps or jumps.
narutoaddon:senjutsu_charging.desc: Hold the keys and stand still to gather nature energy. The pool is kept when you move; it simply stops growing.
narutoaddon:sage_mode.desc: Spends the gathered nature energy to become faster, stronger and harder to kill. The mode ends when the pool runs dry.
narutoaddon:kirin.desc: Calls a real lightning bolt down on the spot you are looking at, but only during a thunderstorm.
narutoaddon:earth_wall.desc: Pulls a wall of the ground up as cover; it stops arrows and mobs, then sinks back and restores what was there.
narutoaddon:rinnegan.desc: A toggle that opens the Rinnegan, raising your chakra and nature-energy capacity and making the powers behind it affordable.
narutoaddon:universal_force.desc: Tap to pull what you are looking at towards you. Hold with sneak to throw everything around you away.
narutoaddon:chibaku_tensei.desc: Hold to build and grow a ball of ground and debris, then let it drop. A longer channel makes a larger ball.
narutoaddon:genjutsu.desc: Hold the seal to take hold of the mob under your gaze. Past half mastery the held seal catches every mob in your line of sight, and the longer it is held the longer the illusion lingers.
narutoaddon:chakra_sensing.desc: Hold to outline every living thing through walls, or tap for a cheaper self-sustaining night vision.
narutoaddon:clone_recall.desc: Calls every clone that can hear you back to your side, workers and fighters alike. Meditating clones stay put.
narutoaddon:henge.desc: Copies the shape and name of the player or mob you are looking at for a minute. A disguise, not a real change.
narutoaddon:storage_chest.desc: Opens your supply chest from anywhere, the same one your worker clones deliver their harvest to.
narutoaddon:fire_breath.desc: Hold to breathe a cone of flame that burns longer and reaches further the longer you channel.
narutoaddon:water_breath.desc: Hold to spray cold water: puts out fires and burning creatures and pushes them back. Water-born prey is hurt by it.
narutoaddon:wind_breath.desc: Hold to blow a hard gust that harms nothing but shoves everything back, strips cobwebs and vines, and snuffs out flames.
narutoaddon:wood_breath.desc: Hold to breathe life into plants in front of you, growing crops, saplings, bamboo and vines like bonemeal.
narutoaddon:water_walk.desc: A toggle that lets you run across water and gives a small speed boost. Costs chakra while it holds.
narutoaddon:chakra_charge.desc: Stand still to pull chakra in quickly, or move for a slower trickle. A full bar briefly speeds up natural regeneration.
narutoaddon:fireball.desc: Shapes a ball of fire and throws it where you are looking; it explodes on impact and sets the ground alight.
narutoaddon:water_bullet.desc: Fires a compact bullet of water that knocks back and douses whatever it hits.
narutoaddon:substitution.desc: Hold to leave a marked log behind; tap to swap places with it or make a short random escape. Uses a substitution charge.
narutoaddon:shadow_clone.desc: Summons a fighting shadow clone that mirrors your gear. Sneak while casting to send it to work instead.
narutoaddon:chibi_shadow_clone.desc: Summons a smaller, cheaper shadow clone. Useful for quick distractions and early fights.
narutoaddon:multi_shadow_clone.desc: Summons four or five shadow clones at once for a large chakra price. More clones come with mastery.
narutoaddon:chakra_meditation.desc: Summons two clones that sit and meditate, refilling your chakra and cooling down your techniques while you stay near.
narutoaddon:chakra_marker.desc: Hold to plant your return log, tap to trade places with it. Planting a new log erases the old one.
narutoaddon:chakra_fist.desc: A toggle that speeds up mining and hardens your melee hits, paid for in chakra as you break blocks and strike.
narutoaddon:chakra_shield.desc: Spends your chakra to raise a shield that absorbs damage hit by hit. It cannot be stacked.
narutoaddon:second_breath.desc: Arms a one-time escape from death: the killing blow is undone, but your vision is dimmed afterwards.
narutoaddon:chakra_regeneration.desc: A toggle that burns chakra and food to close your wounds, letting you heal in the middle of a fight.
narutoaddon:sharingan.desc: Opens the Sharingan: read a target's health, armour and effects, and shake off illusions and blindness.
narutoaddon:amaterasu.desc: Sets the creature you are looking at alight with black flame that ignores water and fire resistance and burns for ten seconds.
narutoaddon:byakugan.desc: Opens the Byakugan: see living things and chakra through walls all around you. While it is open, the mouse wheel draws the world closer, up to ten times.
narutoaddon:rotation.desc: Spin with chakra to destroy incoming projectiles and throw back everything standing close. A tap instead strips your debuffs and hands them to the next body you strike.
narutoaddon:dimension_step.desc: Opens a gate into your pocket cube and remembers the way back. Walking into it takes you there; casting again from inside brings you back, free and even while the gate is on cooldown.
narutoaddon:kagutsuchi.desc: Moves the black flames of Amaterasu: gather them onto your target, or spread them across a group while sneaking.
narutoaddon:senrigan.desc: Opens the Senrigan, the far eye. It gives no bonus by itself; it is the gate for seeing and acting through your clones.
narutoaddon:senrigan_sight.desc: Takes over one of your shadow clones: you fight from its position with your own hands and inventory.
narutoaddon:senrigan_flight.desc: Levitation for an eye-wielder: a toggle that lets you fly while any dojutsu is open, paid for every tick.
narutoaddon:momoshiki_absorption.desc: Hold your palm open to swallow thrown techniques whole, then hand the stolen element back with your next attack.
narutoaddon:leap.desc: A stamina-powered leap in the direction you are looking, from the ground into the air.
narutoaddon:double_jump.desc: A mid-air jump that costs a little chakra and stamina and resets your fall distance.
narutoaddon:bone_tools.desc: Grow a bone multitool from your own skeleton: digs like pickaxe, axe and shovel, fights, tills and strips on right-click. Practice grows a harder tool: nearly harmless at first, a netherite sword's equal only at 90% mastery, lasting 32 to 256 uses. Never stronger than a sword - that is what the Camellia Dance is for. Not repairable.

narutoaddon:rinnegan_prison.desc: Tap to imprison every non-player living creature within 8 blocks (up to 125 max HP), removing them from the world; a tap always captures more, even when prisoners are already held. Hold and release to free them all at once in a ring around the caster for 10 minutes. Released prisoners drop no loot and fall under genjutsu: they never strike the caster, fight his enemies and follow him. While prisoners are held the caster passively gains chakra; if a prisoner dies, the caster gains absorption and the killer is weakened and slowed. Costs 80 chakra; cooldown 30 s. Requires an open Rinnegan.

naruto.skill.rinnegan_prison.desc: Trap a weakened foe in an inescapable chakra prison and draw strength from the captive.

naruto.skill.senrigan_evasion.desc: Learn to let projectiles pass through you and halve melee damage while the Senrigan is open.

naruto.skill.senrigan_guidance.desc: Learn to redirect every attack onto the nearest creature within about 30 degrees of your crosshair, even through walls.
naruto.skill.senrigan_pulse.name: Pulse of the Deep
naruto.skill.senrigan_pulse.desc: Reveals chests, spawners and mechanisms through walls for ten seconds.
naruto.skill.senrigan_freecam.name: Wanderer's Gaze
naruto.skill.senrigan_freecam.desc: Lets the eye leave the body and fly free for up to fifty blocks.
naruto.skill.senrigan_deathmark.name: Mark of Fate
naruto.skill.senrigan_deathmark.desc: Leaves a marker log where you die while the eye is open.
naruto.skill.senrigan_deathstep.name: Step of Fate
naruto.skill.senrigan_deathstep.desc: Teleports you to your marker log once, and the log is spent.
naruto.skill.senrigan_world.name: Dominion
naruto.skill.senrigan_world.desc: Opens a menu that turns the hour and the weather for a great deal of chakra.
narutoaddon:senrigan_evasion.desc: Toggle, Senrigan only: projectiles pass through you without harm and melee damage is halved. Drains 0.5 chakra per tick and 5 chakra per hit or projectile that would have landed; runs out of chakra and the stance ends, letting the next hit through in full.
narutoaddon:senrigan_guidance.desc: Toggle, Senrigan only: every attack you make is redirected onto the living creature closest to your crosshair within 32 blocks and about 30 degrees of your aim, even through walls; a left click on a block hits that creature instead of breaking the block. Drains 0.4 chakra per tick.
narutoaddon:senrigan_pulse.desc: One sweep of the far eye reveals containers, spawners and mechanisms through the stone for ten seconds.
narutoaddon:senrigan_freecam.desc: Sends the eye out of the body: fly the camera freely through stone up to fifty blocks away. Damage or closing the eye brings it back.
